name: app-hotel-detail-and-room-list-phones-around-sunburst-ring-logo
title: Hotel Screens around a Sunburst Ring Logo
whatItIs: A lavender page with two phones (hotel detail and room list) flanking a centre logo tile inside a big ring of white rounded dashes like a sunburst, a third phone cropped at the top and a torn white note explaining the screens.
whatItMeans: The ring of dashes radiates from the logo like a sun, giving a static screen layout a pulse.
techniques: Ring of radial dashes around a logo
Torn paper note under the logo
Cropped extra phone at the top edge
Blue primary buttons and pill chips

vocabulary.definition: Short strokes arranged in a circle radiating outward.
A brand mark placed at the middle of a composition.
Small pills listing amenities like Wi-Fi and food.
